title: Sam Altman revealed AGI is 2 years away

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Sam Altman just dropped a bombshell: AGI is coming in 2 years.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn't just tech—it's a shift that could change everything.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AGI is artificial general intelligence, capable of human-like reasoning.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Altman mentioned breakthroughs in neural network efficiency and adaptability.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects jobs, healthcare, and even how we learn and create.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? The future is accelerating faster than we think.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think we’ll achieve in the next two years?

caption_text: Sam Altman revealed AGI is 2 years away
